quests.instruction: Which meal includes all five food groups?
quests.correctAnswer: Chicken, rice, broccoli, an orange and milk 🍗
options: Chicken, rice, broccoli, an orange and milk 🍗
Cheese pizza with a glass of apple juice 🍕
Spaghetti with garlic bread and butter 🍝
quests.hint: Count how many groups you can name on each plate.
quests.explanation: This meal has protein (chicken), a grain (rice), a vegetable (broccoli), a fruit (orange) and dairy (milk). The others are missing several groups.
quests.funFact: Not every meal needs all five groups. The goal is to mix them across the day.

quests.instruction: A plate has fish, rice, green beans and an apple. Which drink would add the dairy group?
quests.hint: It comes from a cow, a goat or another mammal.
quests.explanation: Milk is a dairy food. Lemonade and water are not counted in the dairy group.
quests.funFact: Dairy foods can also be eaten as yogurt or cheese if you do not like milk to drink.

quests.instruction: A stir-fry has rice, tofu and mixed vegetables. Which food groups does it include?
quests.hint: Think about what rice, tofu and vegetables each count as.
quests.explanation: Rice is a grain, tofu is a protein food and the vegetables are in the vegetable group.
quests.funFact: Stir-frying is a quick cooking method used in many Asian cuisines.

quests.instruction: A child does not drink cow's milk. Which choice can still provide calcium?
options: A bowl of plain white rice 🍚
A glass of clear apple juice 🧃
quests.hint: Look for a plant milk with calcium added.
quests.explanation: Many soy milks have calcium added, so they can stand in for cow's milk. Plain rice and apple juice have very little calcium.
quests.funFact: Food guides count calcium-fortified soy milk with the dairy group.

quests.instruction: Why do children need a wide variety of foods every day?
options: Only grown-ups need variety in their food 🧑
Children simply eat less than adults 🍽️
quests.hint: Ask yourself what is happening to a child's body each year.
quests.explanation: Children are growing, and different foods give the body different nutrients to build with.
quests.funFact: Children's bones keep getting longer and stronger until the teenage years.

quests.instruction: Which vitamin does skin make when it spends time in daylight, and which is also found in eggs and fish?
quests.hint: Think about what skin does when you play outdoors.
quests.explanation: The body makes vitamin D when skin is in daylight. Vitamin C comes from fruit and calcium is a mineral.
quests.funFact: Vitamin D helps the body take in the calcium it needs for strong bones.

quests.instruction: Which sweet food contains natural sugar together with fiber and vitamins?
quests.hint: It is a whole fruit.
quests.explanation: An apple has natural sugar, but it also has fiber and vitamins. Candy and syrup are mostly sugar.
quests.funFact: The sugar in fruit comes packaged with fiber, so fruit is a different kind of sweet from candy.

quests.instruction: Bananas and potatoes are good sources of which mineral that helps muscles and nerves work?
quests.hint: Think of what keeps muscles working smoothly.
quests.explanation: Potassium helps muscles and nerves do their jobs. Calcium builds bones and iron carries oxygen.
quests.funFact: Potassium is also found in beans, oranges and leafy greens.

quests.instruction: What seasoning does the body need only in small amounts?
quests.hint: Too much makes food taste harsh.
quests.explanation: The body needs a little salt, but many foods already contain it. Water and rice are needed in larger amounts.
quests.funFact: Many packaged foods already contain salt, so only a little needs to be added at the table.

quests.instruction: Which snack combines two different food groups?
quests.hint: Count the kinds of food in each snack.
quests.explanation: Apple is a fruit and cheese is dairy, so this snack mixes two groups. The others are only grains.
quests.funFact: Pairing foods from two groups makes a snack more filling and more varied.

quests.instruction: Which snack pairs a vegetable with a protein food?
quests.hint: Beans are a protein food.
quests.explanation: Carrots are a vegetable and bean dip is protein. Apple and banana are both fruits, and crackers and rice cake are both grains.
quests.funFact: Dips made from beans are popular in many countries, such as hummus in the Middle East.

quests.instruction: Which snack mixes a grain food and a dairy food?
quests.hint: Match each food to its group.
quests.explanation: Whole-grain crackers are a grain and cheese is dairy. The other snacks are only fruits or only vegetables.
quests.funFact: Whole-grain crackers keep more fiber than crackers made from white flour.

quests.instruction: Which drink gives calcium and protein as well as helping you stay hydrated?
quests.hint: It comes from a cow, goat or another mammal.
quests.explanation: Milk gives calcium and protein and is mostly water too. Lemonade and sparkling water do not.
quests.funFact: Calcium in milk is easy for the body to take in.

quests.instruction: Which is one important job that water does in the body?
quests.correctAnswer: Helps cool the body through sweat 💧
options: Turns into new muscles and bones 💪
Helps cool the body through sweat 💧
Takes the place of eating food 🍽️
quests.hint: Ask yourself what happens when you play hard.
quests.explanation: Sweat is mostly water, and as it dries on the skin it cools the body down.
quests.funFact: Your body can lose more water on hot days or when you play hard, so drink more then.

quests.instruction: Which food adds plenty of water to your day, along with other nutrients?
quests.hint: You eat it with a spoon.
quests.explanation: Soup is mostly broth, which is water, so it adds to the water a body takes in. Crackers and toast are dry.
quests.funFact: Soups, fruits and vegetables all add to the water the body takes in each day.

quests.instruction: Which is a good way to try a brand-new food?
options: Eat a huge plateful at once 🍴
quests.hint: You do not have to start with a lot.
quests.explanation: Taking a small taste is an easy way to try something new. Many people need to try a food a few times before they decide.
quests.funFact: People often need to try a new food several times before deciding whether they like it.

quests.instruction: Which is a tasty way to eat more vegetables if you do not like them plain?
quests.correctAnswer: Blend them into a soup or sauce 🍅
options: Blend them into a soup or sauce 🍅
Leave them off the plate every time 🗑️
Skip them completely and never try 🚫
quests.hint: Consider changing how they look and taste.
quests.explanation: Blending vegetables into soup or sauce changes their texture and mixes their flavor with other foods.
quests.funFact: Cooking can change a vegetable's taste, texture and sweetness.

quests.instruction: Which words on a food label show that a cereal is made from the whole grain?
quests.hint: Think about using all parts of the grain.
quests.explanation: The phrase whole grain means the entire grain is used. Sugar syrup and natural flavor are other ingredients.
quests.funFact: Labels list ingredients from the largest amount to the smallest.

quests.instruction: Which signal from your body tells you that you may be hungry?
quests.hint: It comes from your tummy.
quests.explanation: A rumbling stomach is one way the body says it is hungry. Sneezing and yawning mean other things.
quests.funFact: Hunger and thirst signals help the body ask for what it needs.

quests.instruction: After a night of sleeping, why is a morning meal helpful?
quests.correctAnswer: It gives the body fuel for the day ⚡
options: It replaces the need for water 💧
It helps you grow taller at once 🌱
It gives the body fuel for the day ⚡
quests.hint: Ask yourself how long it has been since the last meal.
quests.explanation: A morning meal gives the body fuel to start the day. It does not make you grow instantly or replace water.
quests.funFact: Breakfast foods vary around the world, but they all give the body fuel.

quests.instruction: What vitamin helps keep your eyes working properly and is found in carrots, sweet potatoes and mangoes?
quests.hint: Consider orange foods.
quests.explanation: The body turns the orange substances in these foods into vitamin A. Vitamin D comes from sunlight and calcium builds bones.
quests.funFact: Orange and dark green vegetables and fruits are good sources of this vitamin.

quests.instruction: I am a crunchy vegetable that can be red, yellow or green, and I am rich in vitamin C. What am I?
quests.hint: I am hollow inside.
quests.explanation: A bell pepper is crunchy, colorful and full of vitamin C. Potatoes and onions do not match those clues.
quests.funFact: A red bell pepper has more vitamin C than a green one because it has ripened longer.

quests.instruction: Which of these has no fiber at all, because it comes from an animal?
quests.hint: Only one of these foods comes from an animal.
quests.explanation: Cheese comes from milk, so it has no fiber. Whole-wheat bread and pears are plant foods.
quests.funFact: Whole grains, beans, fruits and vegetables are all good sources of fiber.

quests.instruction: Which two foods belong to the same food group?
quests.hint: Think about what each food starts as.
quests.explanation: Yogurt and cheese are both dairy foods made from milk. The other pairs come from different groups.
quests.funFact: Many different dairy foods all begin with milk.

quests.instruction: A party table has only cake, chips and juice. Which food could you bring to add variety?
quests.hint: Picture a different food group.
quests.explanation: A fruit platter adds fruit and fresh color. More cake or candy would add more of the same.
quests.funFact: Fruit platters are popular at parties because they are colorful and easy to share.

quests.instruction: A school lunch tray has milk, a roll, chicken and green beans. Which food would add a fruit?
quests.hint: Look at which group has not appeared yet.
quests.explanation: The tray has dairy, grain, protein and vegetables. Apple slices add the missing fruit.
quests.funFact: School lunch trays in many countries are built from the five food groups.

quests.instruction: A friend eats only foods that come from plants. Which of these can she have?
quests.hint: Check what each dish is made from.
quests.explanation: Lentil soup is made only from plants. An omelet uses eggs and honey is made by bees.
quests.funFact: People follow plant-based diets around the world for health, belief or tradition.

quests.instruction: Which sentence best sums up a balanced way of eating?
quests.correctAnswer: Eating many kinds of food from all groups 🥗
options: Eating the same plain bread every single day 🍞
Eating many kinds of food from all groups 🥗
Eating one favorite food at every meal 🍕
quests.hint: Consider variety.
quests.explanation: Balance means choosing many different foods from all the groups. One food alone cannot give the body everything.
quests.funFact: Food guides from different countries all stress variety.

quests.instruction: Which pair of drinks are good everyday choices for thirst and strong bones?
quests.hint: One is clear and one is white.
quests.explanation: Water quenches thirst and milk gives calcium for bones. Soda, sports drinks and fruit punch usually have added sugar.
quests.funFact: Water and milk are suggested as everyday drinks in many children's food guides.

quests.instruction: Which statement about snacks is true?
quests.correctAnswer: Snacks can add groups missed at meals 🍎
options: Snacks can add groups missed at meals 🍎
Snacks should replace all of your meals 🍽️
Snacks must always be sweet and sugary 🍬
quests.hint: Think about what a snack could add to your day.
quests.explanation: A snack of fruit, yogurt or vegetables can add foods that a meal left out.
quests.funFact: Many people eat several small snacks through the day, and that is fine when the snacks add variety.
